notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAboolean, a logical-time epsilon interval from the adapter-selected standard factory, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time configuration, and federate configuration. The test reads the subject's initial standard HLAtimeRegulating value through the MIM, invokes the opposite standard service, checks the conditional value and timeRegulationEnabled callback when enabling, and restores the observed state. No provider-specific headers, names, registries, or internal APIs are used.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation lifecycle, standard-MIM subscription and attribute-value requests, Enable/Disable Time Regulation services, and FederateAmbassador reflection and timeRegulationEnabled callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::createFederationExecutionWithMIM, RTIambassador::joinFederationExecution, RTIambassador::getTimeFactory, RTIambassador::subscribeObjectClassAttributes, RTIambassador::requestAttributeValueUpdate, RTIambassador::enableTimeRegulation, RTIambassador::disableTimeRegulation, FederateAmbassador::reflectAttributeValues, FederateAmbassador::timeRegulationEnabled, LogicalTimeFactory::makeEpsilon, HLAboolean
